name: Youth Services Workforce Programs (We Can Work, WorkAbility I, WIOA, Transition Partnership)
org: Contra Costa County Office of Education
what_you_do: Get career and school guidance plus a paid work experience that runs all year. The programs are We Can Work, WorkAbility I, WIOA and the Transition Partnership Program.
who_can_apply: Eligible youth ages 16 to 24. The page does not list the rules for each program. Use the referral form or call a Youth Services specialist to find out which program fits you.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The pay rate is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline. The work experience runs all year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Referral Form linked on the program page. Or call the Youth Services Supervisor, Esperanza Ellis, at 925-942-3313.
notes: Youth Services specialists have their own phone lines on the page, for example 925-296-1505 and 925-296-1507. Another card covers the WIOA in-school program from the same office. Businesses can ask to become a worksite with the worksite form on the page.
